Note 1: All other proposed CRs in this agenda 9.3 that have been “Noted” are not included in this CB. Note 2: R3-230556 does not correspond to the RRC reference correction, so this is not included in this CB. This is the summary for the following email discussion: CB: # 11_Email011-NR-U - add RAT type? - RAT restriction handling for primary and secondary RATs? - rev and merge if needed; check details (QC) Summary of offline disc R3-201198 There are two input discussion documents and respective sets of CRs (2x4). I propose we start by considering each of the functional issues, below I have a list but please propose any additions if you spot anything missing. In passing, I would recommend checking and using SA2 requirements and CT specs (related to subscription in particular) as much as possible (although of course these may still change):

[7] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.410, sim=0.5476)
[CR CR0046r3 for 38.410] Reason for change: The WID on NR Timing Resiliency and URLLC enhancements was approved in RP-230754. This CR is to specify the necessary functions and procedures to support the objectives. Summary of change: Describe the Timing Synchronisation Status Reporting function and procedures. Consequences if not approved: Missing stage 2 description of new functions and procedure for NR Timing Resiliency enhancements.

[8] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.470, sim=0.5335)
[CR CR0119r3 for 38.470] Reason for change: The WID on NR Timing Resiliency and URLLC enhancements was approved in RP-230754. This CR is to specify the necessary functions and procedures to support the objectives. Summary of change: Support the Timing Synchronisation Status Reporting function and procedures. Consequences if not approved: Not support of the NR Timing Resiliency and URLLC enhancements.

[9] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.413, sim=0.5315)
[CR CR0099r1 | 38.413] 8.15.1.1General The purpose of the Secondary RAT Data Usage Report procedure is to provide information on the used resources of the secondary RAT (e.g. NR resources during MR-DC operation) as specified in TS 23.501 [9].

[10] (ran3_cr_chunks 38.455, sim=0.5308)
[CR CR0211r1 for 38.455] Reason for change: Section 8.2.1.2 mentions the Inter-RAT Measurement Quantities IE and Inter-RAT Measurement Result IE in the E-CID Measurement Initiation procedure, but these IEs are not defined anywhere. This is likely a copy-paste mistake from LPPa spec and those IEs should instead be renamed Other-RAT Measurement Quantities and Other-RAT Measurement Result, respectively. The Timing Reporting Granularity Factor Extended IE has criticality yes/ignore in ASN.1, but missing in tabular. The list of the TRP measurement quantities contains items that may be of different types. The type of each item in the list is defined in the ‘TRP Measurement Type’ IE. However, in ASN.1, this IE has been named ‘tRPMeasurementQuantities-Item’, as if it was whole item. In 9.2.13, CGI
